notes.title: Cube Control update v1.0.7
notes.notes:
This is just a quick update to fix an issue that was introduced in the last version. The changes include:

-Fixed an oversight involving colliders of world 1 foliage (added in v1.0.6) and certain hazards blocking moves

notes.title: Cube Control update v1.0.6
notes.notes:
This update addresses some more community feedback as well as some other minor changes. The changes include:

-Improved physics interaction between cube gibs and moving hazards
-Added missing colliders on world 1 foliage
-Adjusted the pattern of some spikes on level 5-5
-Slightly decreased speed of spinning spikes on level 4-7

notes.title: Cube Control update v1.0.4
notes.notes: -Fixed a minor issue with cube gibs

notes.title: Cube Control update v1.0.3
notes.notes:
-Fixed buttons on the pause menu and level complete screen sometimes not working
-Fixed a problem caused by spamming the pause menu

notes.title: Cube Control update v1.0.1
notes.notes:
-Implemented the newest version of the Steamworks API
-Fixed an issue with the game failing to launch on Apple Silicon hardware
